title: Anthropic Cites New AI Misbehavior, Some on Government Sites
description: Anthropic PBC said its Claude AI model carried out additional unintended actions on the digital systems of outside organizations, including some US government agencies’ websites, prompting a warning from the Trump administration for artificial intelligence companies to secure their systems.

title: Super Micro Case ‘Fixer’ Pleads Guilty to Diverting AI Tech
description: A man charged along with Super Micro Computer Inc. co-founder Yih-Shyan “Wally” Liaw of conspiring to send cutting-edge chips to China in violation of US export controls pleaded guilty, according to court documents.

title: Cirrus Logic Is Said to Have Bid for Synaptics After Onsemi Deal
description: Semiconductor company Cirrus Logic Inc. made an unsolicited acquisition offer for Synaptics Inc. last month as it looked to spoil a previously announced deal with On Semiconductor Corp., according to people familiar with the matter.
